decision: Keep the live SPCX v3 route and frozen 100/40/80 profit-lock contract unchanged while collecting exact long and short lifecycle evidence.

route_contract.entry_source: fresh completed-bar breakout onset plus receipt-causal pre-close depth-10 pressure
route_contract.opposite_exit: selected eligible opposite intent from the executable same-symbol route closes without same-cycle reversal

signal_census.interpretation: The route has produced usable short cadence, but bidirectional opportunity remains unobserved because no exact v51 long onset has occurred.

resolved_short_lifecycle.interpretation: The lock realized a profitable trade before the path reversed by 60 minutes, but it captured only 36% of observed MFE and price continued favorably for 30 minutes. One path cannot identify a better activation or giveback parameter.

open_short_lifecycle.interpretation: The stronger observed pressure magnitude did not prevent an adverse path. The position remains protected and no eligible opposite onset or profit-lock trigger has occurred, so final economics are unknown.

provisional_combined_economics.warning: The open component is not realized and excludes unknown future slippage, fees, funding, and path behavior. This is not a performance claim.

data_quality_assessment.selection_risk: high because the sample is one resolved winner and one open loss, both short

limitations: Only one lifecycle is resolved and it is the sole source of realized profit.
The second lifecycle is open, so combined economics are right-censored.
No exact v51 long onset or lifecycle has occurred.
The first winner continued favorably after the lock before reversing, leaving profit-lock parameter optimality unresolved.
Canonical regime context is unavailable for this HIP-3 route, so regime-conditioned expectancy cannot yet be measured.
Two short entries cannot distinguish normal variance from parameter fragility or regime dependence.

decision_detail.recommendation: Continue the exact v51 SPCX route unchanged and resolve the open short before considering entry or exit retuning.
decision_detail.why_now: The route has real activity and exact execution evidence, but the apparent edge is one winner offset by one open loss and no long evidence.
decision_detail.alternatives_considered: Tighten the pressure threshold after the current loss, loosen the 100/40/80 lock after the first winner continued, disable shorts, or preserve the frozen contract and collect independent outcomes.
decision_detail.expected_upside: Avoids post-hoc parameter changes while obtaining the exact lifecycle evidence needed to identify whether the route is repeatable and bidirectional.
decision_detail.main_risks: The open short can reach its venue stop; continued observation consumes real risk; sparse outcomes can falsely confirm or reject the route.
decision_detail.validation_completed: Exact profile/run identity, entry decisions, causal pressure provenance, routed actions, fills, costs, stop ownership, lock close, excursion path, and current open state are reconciled in an immutable audit prefix.
decision_detail.validation_still_required: Resolve the open short; observe at least one exact long onset and lifecycle; reconcile every final fee, funding, slippage, exit reason, stop behavior, MFE/MAE, and missed/opposite signal.
decision_detail.success_metrics: Complete attributable lifecycles, zero routing/accounting gaps, positive after-cost net and PF after largest-winner removal, both-side contribution, and no single lifecycle dominating more than half of total improvement.
decision_detail.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Lost stop protection, unaccounted route action, source identity mismatch, repeated cost-adjusted losses, or evidence that the lock systematically destroys more edge than it preserves.
decision_detail.confidence_level: High confidence in technical attribution; low confidence in profitability and parameter optimality.

minimum_evidence_to_update_diagnosis: Resolve xyz:SPCX:517022750282 and obtain the first fully attributed exact-v51 long lifecycle. One resolved lifecycle per side is diagnostic only but closes the current directional identity gap.
minimum_evidence_for_change_proposal: Use a predeclared compatible window with at least ten resolved lifecycles and at least three per side, exact costs and source provenance, positive net and profit factor after removing the largest winner, no lifecycle contributing more than half of net, and an untouched forward confirmation segment. This is a review minimum, not statistical proof.

evidence.role: immutable exact-profile live audit prefix containing the resolved and open SPCX v3 lifecycles

falsifier: Update or reject this observation if the open short resolves, an exact long lifecycle appears, source identity or cost reconciliation fails, or a predeclared compatible sample shows concentration-robust after-cost results materially different from the provisional two-short path.
